text:
leah: quick sync on a compact pin schema for locality + deprecation hints. want to keep resolvers tiny and ops-friendly.

priya: tl;dr goals?

leah: (1) express soft affinity (prefer local zone/region) without hard placement, (2) mark variants deprecated with a burnout window, (3) keep payloads compact for hot caches.

tom: show payload.

leah: example:
```json
{
  "id": "vpin-20260402",
  "model": "redwood-base-7b:2026-04-02",
  "affinity_type": "zone",
  "affinity_id": "us-west2-a",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "deprecated": "soft",  // [none|soft|hard]
  "deprecated_until": "2026-04-09T00:00:00Z",
  "release_epoch": "2026-04-02T15:00:00Z",
  "cohort": "alpha:0.3",
  "meta.rev": "3",
  "creator_id": "ci-release",
  "compact": "true",
  "schema_version": "1.1"
}
```

priya: nice. keeping affinity split into type+id helps indexing.

ryan: behavior: soft deprecated = steer new sessions away but let existing finish. hard = immediate reject new sessions and expedite drain. correct?

leah: yes. resolvers implement fallback: exact zone -> region siblings -> region pool -> global pool. schema only stores affinity.

ops-bot: note: routing-plugin v3.2 will ignore unknown fields; planned opt-in for deprecation semantics next week.

tom: storage/indexing impact?

leah: add composite index (affinity_type, scope) and index on deprecated state. low-cardinality expected. backfill will populate affinity from tenant defaults in two phases: annotate-only, then enable enforcement.

priya: telemetry events?

leah: pin.annotate, pin.deprecation_start, pin.deprecation_enforced, pin.deprecation_cancel. include pin_id, actor, release_epoch, sample_rate.

ryan: ops kill-switch?

leah: routing config flag honor_deprecation=false. also include meta.rev to detect mass accidental updates.

priya: compact responses for hot caches: server may return short arrays like [id,model,affinity_tag,deprecated]. ensure response includes schema_version header.

tom: cohort format as string avoids nested objects. validators must reject invalid affinity formats.

leah: I'll write RFC with schema diff, index cost estimate, backfill/runbook, telemetry sampling, and UI mockups for deprecation timeline.

priya: +1. include stress test for compact array decoding performance.

ryan: +1. call out error modes and a rollout checklist.

leah: thanks, filing RFC tomorrow. ping me for edge cases. :rocket:
